purpose: Scope audit of a primitive-monomial auxiliary assertion used in a prime-degree Keller preprint; no refutation of its Keller conclusion is asserted.

primary_sources.title: There are no Keller maps having prime degree field extensions
primary_sources.use: Context only. The stated general auxiliary implication rare primitive-monomial property implies degree two is contradicted by the uniform examples proved locally. The invertible-Jacobian main conclusion is not contradicted. No claim about the original MathOverflow answer or later versions.
